providers.name: Google Gemini API
providers.free_tier_summary: Ongoing free prototyping tier in Google AI Studio for Flash/Flash-Lite/Gemma models (no credit card required in eligible regions).
providers.rate_limits_summary: Enforced per Google Cloud project across RPM, TPM, and RPD (resets midnight Pacific Time). Exact active numbers vary by model in AI Studio.
providers.usage_restrictions: Free tier is restricted to lighter/standard models; hitting any single RPM/TPM/RPD limit returns 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED.
providers.context_window_summary: Up to 1M tokens on supported Gemini 2.5 models (constrained on free tier by per-minute TPM caps).
providers.data_privacy_summary: IMPORTANT: On the Free Tier, prompts and outputs may be reviewed by human annotators and used by Google to improve products. Upgrade to Paid Tier for strict data privacy.
providers.commercial_usage: Intended for prototyping and testing; public production apps or EEA/UK/Switzerland deployments generally require Paid Billing Terms.
providers.geographic_availability: Available in most countries worldwide; check ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/available-regions (EEA/UK/CH free tier restrictions apply).
known_restrictions: Free-tier prompts may be used for model training and product improvement.
Project-wide RPM/TPM/RPD limits cannot be bypassed by creating extra keys in the same project.
Flagship models or high-throughput workloads require linking a billing account.
setup_steps: Sign in to Google AI Studio at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey with your Google account.
Click 'Create API key' and choose or create a Google Cloud project.
Copy the generated API key and paste it into BEL CODE.
Select 'gemini-2.5-flash' and click Test Connection.

providers.name: Groq
providers.free_tier_summary: Free developer tier with no credit card required, running open-weight models at ultra-low latency on Groq LPUs.
providers.rate_limits_summary: Per-model organization buckets: typically ~30 RPM, ~6,000–8,000 TPM depending on model, and ~1,000–14,400 RPD (see console.groq.com/settings/limits).
providers.usage_restrictions: Low per-minute TPM caps mean large codebase prompts can hit HTTP 429; each model maintains a separate quota bucket.
providers.context_window_summary: Up to 131,072 tokens (128K) on Llama 3.3 70B & Llama 3.1 8B (bounded per request by TPM limits).
providers.data_privacy_summary: Does not use API inputs/outputs to train models; inference payloads are not retained by default (temporary abuse/reliability logs up to 30 days).
providers.commercial_usage: Permitted under Groq Terms of Service within free-tier rate limits; Developer/Enterprise tiers available for production throughput.
known_restrictions: Strict TPM ceilings (often 6K-8K TPM on free tier) require concise prompts or smaller models like llama-3.1-8b-instant.
Model catalog rotates periodically; use Discover Models to query GET /models.
setup_steps: Sign up or sign in at https://console.groq.com/.
Open API Keys (https://console.groq.com/keys) and click 'Create API Key'.
Copy the key (starts with 'gsk_') and paste it into BEL CODE.
Select 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile' (or 'llama-3.1-8b-instant' for high RPM/RPD) and test the connection.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.free_tier_summary: Access zero-cost ':free' community models and the 'openrouter/free' auto-router without a credit card (daily request caps apply).
providers.rate_limits_summary: Free models capped at 20 RPM; 50 requests/day on unfunded accounts (increases to 1,000 requests/day after purchasing $10 lifetime credits).
providers.usage_restrictions: Only models tagged ':free' or 'openrouter/free' are free; switching to non-':free' model IDs charges account credits.
providers.context_window_summary: Varies by active upstream ':free' model (commonly 32K–128K+ tokens).
providers.data_privacy_summary: OpenRouter does not log prompts or completions by default (metadata only; prompt logging is opt-in). Note that third-party upstream free hosts have their own retention policies.
providers.commercial_usage: Permitted subject to OpenRouter Terms and each underlying open-weight model's license and upstream host policy.
known_restrictions: Unfunded free accounts are limited to 50 free requests per day and 20 RPM globally across keys.
Available ':free' model IDs change frequently based on community capacity; 'openrouter/free' automatically selects an available zero-cost model.
setup_steps: Create a free account at https://openrouter.ai/.
Visit https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys and click 'Create Key'.
Copy the 'sk-or-...' key and paste it into BEL CODE.
Keep 'openrouter/free' selected so requests stay strictly at $0.00, then click Test Connection.

providers.name: Mistral AI
providers.free_tier_summary: La Plateforme Free Mode grants no-card API prototyping access to Mistral and Codestral models (requires paid tier for production scale).
providers.rate_limits_summary: Strict Free Mode ceilings (typically ~1 RPS and low RPM/TPM limits visible on your Console Limits page; HTTP 429 with X-RateLimit-Remaining headers).
providers.usage_restrictions: Free Mode is intended for testing and evaluation; production workloads require upgrading to pay-as-you-go Tier 1+.
providers.context_window_summary: Typically 32K–256K depending on model family (e.g., mistral-small-latest, codestral-latest).
providers.data_privacy_summary: Review Mistral Console data settings: Free/Experiment plans may allow data retention/training opt-in unless configured under commercial/enterprise terms.
providers.commercial_usage: Free Mode is for experimentation/prototyping; commercial production apps must upgrade to a paid tier.
known_restrictions: Tight per-second limit (~1 RPS) on Free Mode triggers HTTP 429 during rapid multi-step agent loops unless backoff is used.
Phone verification may be requested when activating Free Mode keys.
setup_steps: Sign in to La Plateforme at https://console.mistral.ai/.
Select the Free/Experiment workspace plan if prompted, then open API Keys (https://console.mistral.ai/api-keys/).
Create and copy your API key into BEL CODE.
Select 'codestral-latest' or 'mistral-small-latest' and run Test Connection.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.free_tier_summary: 10,000 free Neurons per day on Cloudflare's Workers Free plan across edge-hosted open-weight models.
providers.rate_limits_summary: 10,000 Neurons/day hard daily cap on Free plan; resets daily. Paid plan bills $0.011 per 1,000 extra Neurons.
providers.usage_restrictions: Requires both your Cloudflare Account ID and a Workers AI API Token; stops at 10,000 Neurons/day until reset.
providers.context_window_summary: Depends on hosted model (typically 8K–128K across Llama/Qwen/GPT-OSS edge models).
providers.data_privacy_summary: Processed on Cloudflare's serverless GPU network under Cloudflare's Workers AI privacy terms; prompts are not used to train third-party models.
providers.commercial_usage: Workers Free plan is supported for small apps and prototyping within the 10,000 daily Neuron ceiling.
providers.geographic_availability: Available globally across Cloudflare's edge locations.
known_restrictions: Requires substituting your Cloudflare Account ID into the base URL: https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/ai/v1.
Daily 10,000 Neuron budget depletes faster on 70B+ parameter models.
setup_steps: Create or sign in to a free Cloudflare account at https://dash.cloudflare.com/.
Copy your Account ID from the Workers & Pages overview sidebar.
Create an API Token with 'Workers AI Read & Edit' permissions under My Profile -> API Tokens.
Enter both your Account ID and API Token in BEL CODE and click Test Connection.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.free_tier_summary: Free NVIDIA Developer prototyping API access (rate-limited catalog on integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1; replaces legacy trial credits).
providers.rate_limits_summary: Dynamic per-account rate limits (typically ~40 RPM baseline depending on model and queue load).
providers.usage_restrictions: Strictly for prototyping and development evaluation; production workloads require self-hosted NIM or NVIDIA AI Enterprise licensing.
providers.data_privacy_summary: Prompts on free hosted evaluation endpoints may be logged/used by NVIDIA and partners per evaluation terms; self-hosted NIM keeps all data private.
providers.commercial_usage: Evaluation and prototyping only; commercial production requires NVIDIA AI Enterprise or self-hosted NIM licensing.
providers.geographic_availability: Available in supported regions (email/phone verification required for developer program).
known_restrictions: Not licensed for production traffic on the free hosted endpoint.
Subject to queue latency and dynamic RPM throttling.
setup_steps: Sign in with a free NVIDIA Developer account at https://build.nvidia.com/.
Open https://build.nvidia.com/settings/api-keys (or click 'Get API Key' on a model page).
Copy the 'nvapi-...' key into BEL CODE.
Select a model such as 'qwen/qwen2.5-coder-32b-instruct' and test the connection.

providers.name: SambaNova Cloud
providers.free_tier_summary: Free testing/evaluation tier with no payment method required on high-speed SambaNova RDU hardware.
providers.rate_limits_summary: Free Tier enforces tight caps (e.g., 20 RPM, 20 RPD, and 200,000 TPD on production models like DeepSeek-V3.1 & Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct).
providers.usage_restrictions: Free Tier is designed for initial evaluation (20 requests/day cap on major models); linking a payment method unlocks higher Developer Tier limits.
providers.context_window_summary: Up to 128K tokens on production models (DeepSeek-V3.1, Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, gpt-oss-120b).
providers.data_privacy_summary: Customers retain ownership of content; SambaNova hosts open-weight models directly on its RDU infrastructure and does not send prompts to upstream model creators.
providers.commercial_usage: Free Tier is for testing/evaluation; Developer Tier (with payment method) supports production scaling.
known_restrictions: Tight 20 requests/day limit on major models without upgrading to Developer Tier.
200,000 daily token cap on Free Tier.
setup_steps: Sign up at https://cloud.sambanova.ai/ (no credit card needed for Free Tier).
Navigate to API Keys at https://cloud.sambanova.ai/apis and generate a key.
Paste the key into BEL CODE and select 'Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct' or 'DeepSeek-V3.1'.
Click Test Connection.

providers.name: Cerebras Cloud
providers.free_tier_summary: Developer free tier with generous daily token allowance and ultra-fast Wafer-Scale Engine inference (RPM and TPM caps apply).
providers.rate_limits_summary: Organization-level dual-bucket RPM and TPM limits plus daily token allocations (typically up to ~1M tokens/day on free developer tier).
providers.usage_restrictions: Free tier subjects workloads to per-minute token/request caps; HTTP 429 returned when per-minute bursts exceed TPM.
providers.context_window_summary: Up to 128K tokens on supported Llama/Qwen models (bounded on free tier by TPM).
providers.data_privacy_summary: Check Cerebras Cloud API Terms in the console for current inference logging and enterprise ZDR options.
providers.commercial_usage: Permitted for development and prototyping within free-tier quotas; paid tiers available for guaranteed SLAs.
providers.geographic_availability: Available in supported regions via cloud.cerebras.ai.
known_restrictions: Rapid agent loops can burst past per-minute TPM even when daily tokens remain.
setup_steps: Register or sign in at https://cloud.cerebras.ai/.
Open 'API Keys' in the Cerebras dashboard and create a key.
Paste the key into BEL CODE.
Select 'llama-3.3-70b' or 'qwen-3-32b' and test the connection.

providers.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
providers.free_tier_summary: Small recurring monthly credit allowance ($0.10/month on Free accounts; $2.00/month on PRO) across serverless partner providers.
providers.rate_limits_summary: Stops once the $0.10/month free credit allowance is exhausted unless upgraded to PRO or pay-as-you-go billing.
providers.usage_restrictions: Small monthly credit cap ($0.10/mo free) suitable only for light experimentation.
providers.context_window_summary: Depends on chosen partner model (formatted as organization/model-name).
providers.data_privacy_summary: Data handling depends on both Hugging Face's router and the selected downstream serverless provider.
providers.commercial_usage: Lightweight experimentation under the free monthly credit; partner billing applies beyond credit.
providers.geographic_availability: Available globally where Hugging Face Hub operates.
known_restrictions: $0.10/month free credit depletes quickly during multi-turn coding sessions.
Not a high-volume unlimited free tier.
setup_steps: Sign in at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens.
Create a fine-grained Access Token with 'Make calls to Inference Providers' enabled.
Paste the 'hf_...' token into BEL CODE.
Select a model and click Test Connection.

providers.name: GitHub Models
providers.free_tier_summary: Free prototyping playground accessible with a GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT) with 'models:read' scope.
providers.rate_limits_summary: Strict prototyping caps enforced by RPM, RPD (UserByModelByDay), Tokens-Per-Request (TPR), and concurrent requests.
providers.usage_restrictions: Explicitly restricted to prototyping and experimentation; not licensed or sized for production backends.
providers.context_window_summary: Low per-request input/output token caps on the free playground tier (often 8K input / 4K output on high-tier models).
providers.data_privacy_summary: Governed by GitHub / Azure AI model terms for GitHub Models playground usage.
providers.commercial_usage: Prototyping only; transition to Azure AI Foundry / direct provider keys for production.
providers.geographic_availability: Available wherever GitHub and Azure AI Models operate.
known_restrictions: Low per-request token limits can reject very large context payloads.
setup_steps: Go to https://github.com/settings/tokens and create a fine-grained Personal Access Token.
Grant the 'Models' -> 'Read' account permission to the token.
Paste the GitHub token into BEL CODE and select 'openai/gpt-4o-mini'.
Click Test Connection.

providers.name: Ollama (Local AI)
providers.free_tier_summary: 100% free, offline, and private local inference on your own CPU/GPU using Ollama (no API key or cloud account needed).
providers.rate_limits_summary: No API quotas or rate limits; throughput and context speed depend strictly on your local RAM/VRAM and CPU/GPU.
providers.usage_restrictions: Requires installing Ollama locally and downloading open-weight model files (several GBs of disk/RAM).
providers.context_window_summary: Configurable locally (default often 4K–32K depending on model and available VRAM).
providers.data_privacy_summary: Complete privacy: 100% of prompts, code, and completions stay locally on your machine.
providers.commercial_usage: Open-weight models run locally subject to each model's license (e.g., Apache 2.0, MIT, Llama Community License).
known_restrictions: Hardware-dependent: 7B–14B models typically need 8–16 GB RAM/VRAM; larger 32B+ models require 24+ GB VRAM/unified memory.
Ollama daemon must be running at http://localhost:11434.
setup_steps: Install Ollama from https://ollama.com/download.
Open a terminal and pull a coding model: 'ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:7b'.
Ensure Ollama is running (starts automatically on desktop, or run 'ollama serve').
Click 'Discover Models' and 'Test Connection' in BEL CODE (no API key needed).

providers.name: FreeLLMAPI (Local Gateway)
providers.free_tier_summary: Self-hosted local OpenAI-compatible router (port 31415 or 3001) that unifies your own free provider keys with smart routing and fusion.
providers.rate_limits_summary: Enforces whichever upstream provider free-tier limits belong to the keys you configure inside your local FreeLLMAPI router.
providers.usage_restrictions: Requires running the local FreeLLMAPI server on port 31415 (or 3001) with at least one upstream key.
providers.context_window_summary: Dynamic across configured upstream models (typically 32K–128K tokens).
providers.data_privacy_summary: Router runs locally on your machine and forwards prompts only to the upstream providers you configure.
providers.commercial_usage: Depends on the upstream free/paid providers configured in your router.
providers.geographic_availability: Runs locally anywhere; upstream provider availability varies.
known_restrictions: Requires the local FreeLLMAPI router service running on http://localhost:31415/v1 (or :3001/v1).
Uses unified 'freellmapi-...' tokens generated by your local router (not third-party cloud keys).
setup_steps: Install and start your local FreeLLMAPI gateway (default port 31415).
Add your upstream free provider keys inside the FreeLLMAPI web UI (http://localhost:31415).
Copy your unified 'freellmapi-...' token and paste it into BEL CODE.
Leave Base URL as http://localhost:31415/v1 and click Test Connection.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.free_tier_summary: Pay-as-you-go commercial API (requires funded billing account on OpenAI Platform).
providers.rate_limits_summary: Usage Tier based (Tier 1–Tier 5 RPM/TPM scaling with spend history).
providers.usage_restrictions: Not a free API tier; requires prepaid credits.
providers.data_privacy_summary: OpenAI does not train on API business/platform traffic by default.
providers.commercial_usage: Full commercial production usage under OpenAI API Terms.
providers.geographic_availability: Supported OpenAI API countries and territories.
known_restrictions: Paid service; charges per 1M input/output tokens.
setup_steps: Sign in to https://platform.openai.com/api-keys.
Add billing credits if required, create a project API key ('sk-...'), and paste it into BEL CODE.
Select your preferred model (e.g., gpt-4o-mini or gpt-4o) and test the connection.

providers.name: Anthropic Claude
providers.free_tier_summary: Pay-as-you-go commercial API via Anthropic Console (small evaluation credits may appear on select new verified accounts, not an ongoing free tier).
providers.rate_limits_summary: Build Tier 1–4 RPM/ITPMS/OTPM limits visible in console.anthropic.com.
providers.usage_restrictions: Not a permanently free API tier; requires billing credits after any promotional evaluation balance.
providers.context_window_summary: 200K tokens across Claude 3.5 / 3.7 Sonnet & Haiku models.
providers.data_privacy_summary: Commercial API prompts and outputs are not used to train generative models by default.
providers.commercial_usage: Full commercial production usage under Anthropic Commercial Terms.
known_restrictions: Paid service; charges per token usage.
setup_steps: Sign in at https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys.
Create an API key ('sk-ant-...') and ensure Console billing credits are available.
Paste the key into BEL CODE and click Test Connection.

providers.name: Custom OpenAI / Anthropic Endpoint
providers.free_tier_summary: Connect any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible gateway (LM Studio, vLLM, LiteLLM, llama.cpp server, or private proxy).
providers.rate_limits_summary: Determined by your custom server or endpoint.
providers.usage_restrictions: Set Base URL, Model ID, and optional API key without modifying BEL CODE source code.
providers.data_privacy_summary: Depends entirely on the target endpoint you specify.
providers.commercial_usage: Determined by your target provider/self-hosted model.
providers.geographic_availability: Any reachable URL or localhost server.
known_restrictions: Must expose '/v1/chat/completions' (OpenAI) or '/v1/messages' (Anthropic) compatible REST routes.
setup_steps: Start your local server (e.g., LM Studio, vLLM, LiteLLM) or obtain your endpoint Base URL.
Enter the Base URL (e.g., http://localhost:1234/v1) and exact Model ID in BEL CODE.
Add an API key if your server requires authentication, then click Test Connection.
